candidates.name: Kettlebell Chest Press (Single)
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Chest Press (Single)
Beginner
1
Laying on the floor with your knees bent and feet firmly on the floor, hold the kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
2
Fully extend your arms, raising the kettlebell until your elbows are locked.
3
Lower the kettlebell to the starting position and repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Press
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Press
Beginner
1
Laying on the floor with your knees bent and feet firmly on the floor, leave one arm resting to the side of the body.
2
Using the other arm, hold the kettlebell at arms length directly upwards of your shoulder.
3
Lower your arm until your upper arm to elbow is resting on the floor.
4
Return to starting position.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Chest Fly
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Chest Fly
Beginner
1
Lie on the floor with your knees bent and feet firmly on the floor, with your arms to the side of your body.
2
Holding a kettlebell in one hand, keeping your arm fully extended with a slight bend in the elbow and your forearms facing upwards, lift the kettlebell above your chest.
3
Lower the kettlebell to the starting position and repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Walkover Pushup
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Walkover Pushup
Advanced
1
Starting in a press up position with feet wide and one hand resting on the kettlebell, complete a full press up, lowering your chest towards the ground while keeping your body straight and returning to the starting position.
2
Swap hands on the kettlebell, placing the hand originally on the kettlebell underneath your shoulder, complete another press up.
3
Repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Floor Fly
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Floor Fly
Novice
1
Lie on your back holding kettlebells above chest with slight elbow bend.
2
Lower arms out wide until elbows lightly touch the floor.
3
Bring kettlebells back together over chest, squeezing pecs at the top.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Floor Fly
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Floor Fly
Novice
1
Lie on your back holding one kettlebell above chest with slight elbow bend.
2
Lower arm out wide until elbow lightly touches the floor.
3
Bring kettlebell back over chest, squeezing pec at the top.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Chest Press
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Chest Press
Beginner
1
Lie on bench holding one kettlebell above chest with arm extended.
2
Lower kettlebell toward chest while keeping torso stable.
3
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without twisting.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Incline Chest Press
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Incline Chest Press
Intermediate
1
Sit on incline bench holding kettlebell at shoulder with elbow bent.
2
Press kettlebell upward and slightly inward until arm fully extends.
3
Lower slowly to starting position, keeping torso stable and controlled.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm High Incline Chest Press
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm High Incline Chest Press
Intermediate
1
Sit on high incline bench holding kettlebell at shoulder height.
2
Press kettlebell upward and slightly inward until arm fully extends.
3
Lower slowly to start position, keeping torso stable and controlled.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Larsen Press
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Larsen Press
Intermediate
1
Start in a bench press position with your legs elevated. Try to keep your knees with a slight bend in them.
2
Lower kettlebells toward chest while keeping legs elevated and torso stable.
3
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without arching lower back.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Larsen Press
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Larsen Press
Intermediate
1
Lie on bench with feet off floor, holding one kettlebell above chest.
2
Lower kettlebell toward chest while keeping core tight and legs raised.
3
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without twisting torso.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Incline Guillotine Bench Press
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Incline Guillotine Bench Press
Intermediate
1
Lie on bench, hold kettlebell with both hands over chest.
2
Lower kettlebells, elbows flared.
3
Press kettlebells upward, fully extending arms. Repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Floor Press
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Floor Press
Novice
1
Start flat on your back with a kettlebell extended over you.
2
Bring your elbow to the floor, rest for a second to remove all the momentum from the rep, then press to a lockout.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Floor Press
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Floor Press
Novice
1
Start flat on your back with the kettlebells extended over you.
2
Bring your elbows to the floor, rest for a second to remove all the momentum from the rep, then press to a lockout.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Incline Bench Press
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Incline Bench Press
Beginner
1
Position the bench between 30 and 45 degrees.
2
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground.
3
Lower the kettlebells to your mid chest
4
Raise the kettlebells (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.

candidates.name: Kettlebell High Incline Bench Press
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell High Incline Bench Press
Beginner
1
Position the bench between 45 and 60 degrees.
2
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground.
3
Lower the kettlebells to your mid chest
4
Raise the kettlebells (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.
